name: malecns-neuromuscular-readout
description: Named-population readout from the MaleCNS v1.0 CSR to normalized motor channels.

source.body_id_policy: Population specifications use annotated neuron type and annotation fields only; no body ID is inferred or invented.

contract_provenance.note: The population signal is graph-derived; conversion into SI MotorCommand uses caller-supplied calibration scales and is therefore a fitted/readout boundary.

direction_convention.left_right: Signed steering channels use explicit right-minus-left semantics; bilateral activity channels do not invent a lateral sign.
direction_convention.physical_wing: wing_motor_left and wing_motor_right use exact superclass:vnc_motor&subclass:wm/L and /R selectors; DNg02 flight_power remains a compatibility readout.
direction_convention.front_back: Leg selectors retain front/middle/hind pools; DNp01/TTMn/DNp11/DNp02/DNp04 have no annotated front/back sign and are marked not_encoded.
direction_convention.escape_readout: jump is the DNp01 decision/event compatibility channel; ttmn_activity and jump_motor are independent TTMn physical motor readouts; dnp11_activity, dnp02_activity, and dnp04_activity remain independent normalized activities.
direction_convention.behavior_policy: No sensory trigger, behavioral state, or conditional activation is defined by this map.

input_semantics.dense_rates_hz: per-neuron mean rate over the supplied window; MaleCNS one-tick 0/1000-dt rates are accumulated before readout
input_semantics.dense_spikes: per-neuron spike counts accumulated over the supplied window
input_semantics.population_rates_hz: named population mean rate in Hz; an explicit population map takes precedence over a dense vector
input_semantics.population_spike_counts: named population total count over the supplied window

readout.rate_clipping: each term is baseline-subtracted, normalized by its explicit r_max_hz, then clipped to its channel bounds
readout.signed_steering: right-minus-left wing command, with DNg02 contralateral and DNp03 contraversive signs from MotorMap.java

wing.bilateral_policy: mean flight power plus/minus signed steering; each wing is independently clipped

provenance.engine: scripts/malecns_engine.py MaleCNSEngine emits instantaneous per-neuron rates from spikes
provenance.map: FLYB v1 annotations.npz + tables.json; population selectors are resolved at construction
provenance.anchors: r_max_hz values are explicit fitted/readout anchors, not in-vivo firing-rate claims
provenance.evidence: docs/GPU_INTEGRATION_CHECKLIST.md §Other blocking or high-risk findings and docs/EXPERIMENT_LOG.md §六

flight_power.description: Graded wingbeat power command from all annotated DNg02 wingbeat-power descending neurons.
flight_power.provenance: DNg02 population and wingbeat-power role are documented in MotorMap.java and dn-behavior.md §4.2/§2.2.

terms.provenance: All CSR type names beginning DNg02; resolved from tables.json.

flight_steering.description: Signed lateral wing command; positive values increase right-wing drive in the digital-body convention.
flight_steering.provenance: DNg02 is contralateral; DNp03 is contraversive. Signs follow MotorMap.java flightYaw and dn-behavior.md §4.2.

terms.provenance: Annotated left-side DNg02 cells; side is read from tables.json.
Annotated right-side DNg02 cells; side is read from tables.json.
Named DNp03 left cell in CSR; contraversive sign from dn-behavior.md §2.2.
Named DNp03 right cell in CSR; contraversive sign from dn-behavior.md §2.2.

wing_motor.description: Diagnostic readout of the annotated wing motor-neuron pool; it does not gate flight power.
wing_motor.provenance: superclass:vnc_motor & subclass:wm is the CSR wing motor pool (67 cells).

terms.provenance: CSR annotations: superclass vnc_motor, subclass wm; no body IDs used.

wing_motor_left.description: Independent physical left-wing activation from the exact left VNC wing-motor pool.
wing_motor_left.provenance: Exact annotation selector superclass:vnc_motor&subclass:wm/L; physical wing source is separate from DNg02 flight_power.

terms.provenance: Exact left-side CSR wing motor selector; no aggregate or body ID is substituted.

wing_motor_right.description: Independent physical right-wing activation from the exact right VNC wing-motor pool.
wing_motor_right.provenance: Exact annotation selector superclass:vnc_motor&subclass:wm/R; physical wing source is separate from DNg02 flight_power.

terms.provenance: Exact right-side CSR wing motor selector; no aggregate or body ID is substituted.

leg_power.description: Mean drive of the front, middle, and hind VNC leg motor pools.
leg_power.provenance: Leg motor subclasses fl/ml/hl are verified in dn-behavior.md §2.3; superclass filter excludes descending neurons carrying a leg annotation.

terms.provenance: Annotated front-leg motor neurons only.
Annotated middle-leg motor neurons only.
Annotated hind-leg motor neurons only.

leg_steering.description: Right-minus-left leg motor drive, separately balanced across front/middle/hind pools.
leg_steering.provenance: Motor-level asymmetry follows MotorMap.java legMotorAsym; each side is resolved from CSR side annotations.

terms.provenance: Right front-leg motor pool.
Right middle-leg motor pool.
Right hind-leg motor pool.
Left front-leg motor pool.
Left middle-leg motor pool.
Left hind-leg motor pool.

mouth.provenance: MN9 is the validated rostrum-extension motor readout; DNg67, DNge080, DNge173 and DNge174 are named feeding DNs in dn-behavior.md §1.9.

ttmn_activity.event_semantics: accepts named rates or spike counts; a positive TTMn rate is retained as activity
ttmn_activity.description: Independent TTMn activity readout for the physical motor boundary.
ttmn_activity.provenance: Exact CSR selector TTMn; TTMn is the motor-neuron source for the physical jump endpoint, distinct from DNp01 decision activity.

terms.provenance: Strict exact type TTMn; no prefix or synonym selector is used.

jump_motor.description: Physical jump motor event sourced from TTMn activity.
jump_motor.provenance: Exact CSR selector TTMn; this is the physical jump motor readout. DNp01 remains the separate legacy decision event.

terms.provenance: Strict exact type TTMn; one positive event is exposed to the physical layer.

dnp11_activity.description: Independent normalized activity readout for the DNp11 population.
dnp11_activity.provenance: Exact CSR type DNp11; this is a source-preserving rate readout, not a behavioral gate.

dnp02_activity.description: Independent normalized activity readout for the DNp02 population.
dnp02_activity.provenance: Exact CSR type DNp02; this is a source-preserving rate readout, not a behavioral gate.

dnp04_activity.description: Independent normalized activity readout for the DNp04 population.
dnp04_activity.provenance: Exact CSR type DNp04; this is a source-preserving rate readout, not a behavioral gate.

uncertainties.item: Absolute in-vivo firing-rate anchors for most DNg02, DNp03, and leg/grooming populations
uncertainties.handling: r_max_hz values are explicit readout calibration anchors, not claims of measured biology.

uncertainties.item: Exact biomechanics of how neural steering drive maps to wing forces
uncertainties.provenance: digital_body.py is a reduced deterministic body model, not a validated CFD/multibody model
uncertainties.handling: adapter emits normalized left/right wing drives and does not invent SI forces or torques.

uncertainties.item: Population aliases such as aDN1/aDN2, Fudog, Rounddown, and Bract
uncertainties.handling: only the actual CSR type names DNg62, DNge078, DNg67, DNge080, DNge173, and DNge174 are used.
